title: Russell US Style indexes — conditional quarter-end capping check effective at the open of 2027-03-31 (24% / 4.8%-above-48% test struck on the 2027-03-25 close, Good Friday moving T-3 back a trading day)
source: EST: owner-published standing rule, both governing documents re-fetched and re-extracted first-hand this session rather than inherited from the proposal or from any sibling ledger. FTSE Russell, "Capping Methodology Guide", v5.4, September 2026 (lseg.com dam policy-documents, capping-methodology-guide.pdf, HTTP 200, 652,008 bytes, 62 content streams inflated and text-extracted in-session 2026-09-09 — the identical byte count and stream count three siblings recorded, so this is provably the same edition they read): section 4.8.6 gives every Russell US Style row frequency "Monthly", price date "T-3", effective date "Last business day of each month", trigger "No company is greater than 24%, and all companies that have a weight greater than 4.8% in aggregate are no more than 48% of the index", scheme "Rule 4.2/RIC 22.5/45". FTSE Russell, "Frequently Asked Questions — Russell US Equity Indexes", July 2026 (same host, ftse-faq-document-russell-us-equity-2026.pdf, HTTP 200, 198,134 bytes, 19 streams, re-fetched 2026-09-09 after one transient 404): its schedule table's four capping rows were read at the column level and its March 2026 column reads verbatim "Russell US Style Capping Cut-Off Date — 11 March 2026", "Review Effective Date (open of) — 23 March 2026", "Russell US Style Quarter-end Capping Cut-Off Date — 26 March 2026", "Russell US Style Quarter-end Capping Effective Date (open of, if applicable) — 31 March 2026". THE 2027 DATE IS RULE-DERIVED, NOT PUBLISHED — the FAQ's dated table carries 2026 rows only, and it closes with "NOTE: Dates may be subject to change." The derivation: last business day of March 2027 is Wednesday 2027-03-31, and the FAQ's own words are "closing prices from three TRADING days prior to the last business day of the quarter", so T-3 steps over Good Friday 2027-03-26 — a full NYSE closure, read this session from NYSE's own Holidays and Trading Hours page (HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes), whose 2027 column reads "Good Friday — Friday, March 26", corroborated by this repo's src/domain/market-calendar.ts — landing on Thursday 2027-03-25. That trading-day rule reproduced all four of the owner's published 2026 quarter-end cut-offs to the day when re-derived independently here (26 Mar, 25 Jun, 25 Sep, 28 Dec). March is a quarter-end under BOTH readings of the owner's disputed frequency wording, so this instance needs no position on that conflict. Filed estimate because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and because the confirmed-tier prefixes have no member for an index owner's own published methodology — the date is not in doubt, the label is about the taxonomy. Discovered by the russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-06-30 initial research 2026-09-08; canonical file written and every source re-verified by this event's own initial research 2026-09-09
notes: Impact low and symbols deliberately EMPTY, re-verified this session rather than inherited: `docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md` and `docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md` re-grepped for `rebalanc|reconstitution|russell|capping|index.flow|IWF|IWY` → 0 hits in both, so no house playbook is index-flow-keyed; a fired recap moves roughly $478M across five of the most liquid names on the tape; and an ETF proxy in `symbols` would make the deterministic screen trip on mega-cap beta rather than on anything about this rule. THE HEADLINE OF THIS EVENT'S RESEARCH IS A DOCUMENT FINDING THAT SETTLES A QUESTION THREE SIBLING LEDGERS LEFT OPEN. Guide v5.4 §4.8.3, quoted verbatim: "The index weights used in the test are calculated using closing constituent prices on the price date and incorporate forward-looking constituents, shares in issue, and investability weights, including any current capping adjustments, designated to take effect on or before the effective date specified in Section 4.8.6." That is a direct answer to the question the russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-06-30 ledger called "the single unresolved question the sheet's whole band rests on" — the T-3 test reads the FORWARD-LOOKING index, so a capping adjustment effective on or before the quarter-end effective date is incorporated even when it takes effect after the price date. For March 2027 both readings agree anyway (review effective 2027-03-22 precedes the 2027-03-25 test); the finding matters most for June, where it collapses that sibling's 2.17% / 18.91% / 43.43% band onto its cut-off-anchor end. SECOND FINDING, ALSO CARRIED FORWARD: a fourth independent rebuild of this family's base-rate arithmetic reproduces the September and December siblings and identifies the cause of the June session's disagreement with them — a cohort index based at the sample start rather than re-based at each window start, which over-weights NVDA inside the cohort by five years of its own outperformance and roughly doubles every rate. Corrected, this instance's 11-session drift window (2027-03-10 review cut-off → 2027-03-25 test) prices at 40/1,243 = 3.22%, not the 6.68% the proposal quoted.
